assay: bulk RNA-seq (KAPA stranded RiboErase, HiSeq 3000 50bp SE), prostate tumor tissue of male TRAMP mice (S4.6.p1)
sample_inclusion: 18 male TRAMP mice randomized 1:1:1 to control, exercise (voluntary wheel running, singly housed), Phellodendron amurense extract diet (S4.2.p1); 12-week intervention; tumors from 3 representative animals per group sequenced (S2.2.p1, S4.6.p1)
primary_estimand: Effect of 12 weeks of voluntary wheel running vs no intervention on prostate tumor gene expression in TRAMP mice (S2.2.p1)
planned_contrasts: Phellodendron amurense extract vs control (S2.2.p2; paper: 176 DEGs, 100 down / 76 up)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one tumor per animal, independent animals
normalization: DESeq size-factor normalization of HTSeq counts (S4.7.p1)
paper_method: R package DESeq (original), group-pairwise comparisons on HTSeq counts; TopHat to UCSC genome (S4.7.p1)

paper_threshold.extra_filter: at least one group average RPKM > 1

paper_results.exercise_vs_control: 32 DEGs; down: Lipe, Plin1, Slc7a10, Gpr83; up: Dgat2l6 (S2.2.p1, S3.p1)
paper_results.pham_vs_control: 176 DEGs (100 down, 76 up); down Spink3, Spink5, Slc26a4, Slc45a3, Slc5a8, Apof, Pls1, Mmp7, Dclk3, Gstt3, Atp2c2; up Dcx, Sncb (S2.2.p2, S3.p2)
paper_results.overlap: BB123696 and Lman1l up in both (S2.2.p3)
